# Nigeria flood — `nga-flooding`

This is the endorsed 2026 revision of Nigeria's flood anticipatory action framework, focused on **Adamawa state** along the Benue river. The action trigger is a **multi-gauge consensus design**: fires when ≥6 of 10 selected Google GRRR gauges simultaneously exceed their individual 4-year return-period threshold, replacing the 2025 single-station OR logic (GloFAS OR GRRR at one Wuroboki gauge). A **GloFAS readiness trigger** (ensemble reforecast mean > 3,132 m³/s at Wuroboki, lead time ≤13 days) gives partners advance notice ahead of the action trigger, **OR**-ed with a GloFAS reanalysis safety-net branch — this OR-branch, previously only in the (unpublished) framework document while the repo analysis recommended against it, is now implemented in code. The 2025 **NHF flash-flood** component (observational, BAY states) is retained unchanged; its 2026 LGA-retargeting work, visible in the prior sync, is not present in this checkout. Email dispatch now runs through **Listmonk/ocha-relay** rather than raw SMTP. No funding envelope, implementing agencies, or target population are recorded (the framework document is pending publication). The 2026 design is fully coded but **not yet running anywhere**: PR #37 is still open, the pre-merge cron shim meant to run it is itself on an unmerged branch (PR #38), and `monitoring.yml` on `main` is `disabled_inactivity`.

**Current version:** [2026-06-18](2026-06-18.md) · status: **endorsed** · repo `ocha-dap/ds-aa-nga-flooding`
